summary: Spevack Law Firm is a family-founded New Jersey trial firm (est. 1928) based at 525 Green Street in Iselin, with additional by-appointment offices in New Brunswick and Shrewsbury. It handles personal injury, workers' compensation, criminal/municipal, family and Social Security matters, markets itself as available 24/7 for new cases, and routes intake through one phone number and a single web appointment form. The site is agency-built WordPress, carries a live-chat widget, and its blog has been dormant since 2021.

facts.fact: Firm states it has served Middlesex County clients since 1928 and describes itself as a full-service firm specializing in civil litigation, personal injury and workers' compensation.
Office network: headquarters at 525 Green Street, Iselin (Woodbridge Township); 1161 Broad St., Suite 318, Shrewsbury (by appointment only); 5 Elm Row, Suite 104, New Brunswick (by appointment only).
Published hours are Mon-Fri 9:00AM-5:00PM and Sat 9:00AM-2:00PM, Sunday closed, while the site simultaneously advertises 'AVAILABLE 24/7 FOR NEW CASES!'.

Public attorney roster lists seven lawyers: David R. Spevack (Managing Partner/President), partners John E. Gregory Jr., Robert Heck and Keith Kandel (workers' comp supervising attorney), Of Counsel Howard Sims and Anthony M. DeBari, and Samuel A. Freiheiter, plus memorial pages for founders I. Oscar Spevack and Ronald Wm. Spevack.

Practice areas listed on the site are personal injury/wrongful death, motor vehicle accidents, truck accidents, dog bites, slip and fall, workers' compensation, Social Security appeals, criminal law, municipal court, divorce, child custody/support, and juvenile delinquency.
Every lawyer offers a free consultation; the practice-areas page tells prospects to call or 'use the case review form on our site'.

Primary call-to-action is phone (732) 636-3030; the 'Make an Appointment' button leads to a Gravity Forms contact form capturing name, email, phone, a 'Consultation For' practice-area dropdown, message and reCAPTCHA - no calendar or scheduling integration.

Firm's 2020 COVID-19 notice says the practice is 'fully electronic', attorneys and staff can access all systems via a secure server remotely, phone systems are accessible remotely, new-client meetings moved to phone with scanned documents and an e-signature platform for fee agreements.
Firm publishes case results including a $4,100,000 pre-trial settlement (tractor-trailer), a $2,735,455 net jury verdict (garbage truck, Essex County) and a $2,600,000 medical malpractice recovery.
Blog's most recent posts are from 2021 (a May 2021 Perth Amboy tennis-court sponsorship and a March 2021 CLE program), indicating no new content since then.
David R. Spevack is described as President and Managing Partner, Rutgers Law 2001, licensed in NJ/NY, a municipal prosecutor since 2009, and fluent in Spanish.

Avvo city directory lists firm partner John Edward Gregory at 525 Green Street with a 5.0 rating from 1 review, and lists another personal injury attorney (Louis Andrew Mangione, 5.0/3 reviews) under 'Spevack Law Firm' at the same address; Mangione does not appear on the firm's own attorney roster.
No careers page exists at the firm's domain (returns HTTP 404), and SimplyHired returned '0' job results for Spevack Law Firm when checked.

Homepage source code shows WordPress, Yoast SEO schema, Gravity Forms with reCAPTCHA, Tawk.to live-chat embed (property 5e3c49df298c395d1ce6944d), Google Tag Manager (GTM-WN2F2LK), a legacy Universal Analytics tag (UA-158529786-1), a Google Translate plugin, and a footer credit 'Website by BFM' (BiggerFishMarketing).

operations_signals: Single intake phone number (732) 636-3030 is the primary conversion path on every page; there is no online booking/calendar, only a web form (https://www.woodbridgelawfirm.com/)

Appointment form asks only name, email, phone, practice-area dropdown and free-text message - no case-qualification questions such as accident date, injury type, insurance carrier or statute-of-limitations check (https://www.woodbridgelawfirm.com/)
Two of three offices (New Brunswick, Shrewsbury) are 'by appointment only', so staff must coordinate meeting logistics across locations (https://www.woodbridgelawfirm.com/contact-us/)

Advertised 24/7 new-case availability conflicts with posted staffed hours Mon-Fri 9-5 and Sat 9-2; nothing on the site describes an after-hours answering service or callback promise (https://www.woodbridgelawfirm.com/)
Live-chat widget (Tawk.to) is installed sitewide, but no chat hours, staffing or response-time commitment is published (https://www.woodbridgelawfirm.com/)
Free consultations offered across practice areas, implying high-volume intake screening before fee agreements are signed (https://www.woodbridgelawfirm.com/practice-areas/)
Bilingual operation: managing partner speaks Spanish fluently and the site has a Spanish-language section and Google Translate toggle (https://www.woodbridgelawfirm.com/attorney/david-r-spevack/)

Firm describes itself as fully electronic with remote access to case systems and remote phone access, i.e. an existing digital file backbone that new tools could plug into (https://www.woodbridgelawfirm.com/spevack-law-firm-covid-19-response/)
hiring_signals: No careers/employment page on the firm's website - /careers/ returns HTTP 404, so no roles are advertised there (https://www.woodbridgelawfirm.com/careers/)
SimplyHired shows zero job postings attributed to Spevack Law Firm at time of check (https://www.simplyhired.com/search?q=Spevack+Law+Firm)
Talent.com's keyword results for the firm surfaced only unrelated employers, i.e. no firm-specific postings indexed (https://www.talent.com/jobs?k=Spevack+Law+Firm)

Site copy references 'attorneys and staff' working remotely and handling calls, implying an existing non-attorney support group (paralegals/assistants/reception) whose size is not published (https://www.woodbridgelawfirm.com/spevack-law-firm-covid-19-response/)
review_themes: Firm-published testimonials (10 entries) consistently praise responsiveness, personal attention from the managing partner, and staff who 'speak Spanish fluently' (https://www.woodbridgelawfirm.com/testimonials/)

One testimonial credits partners with taking client phone calls directly and traveling to a client's home for an intake meeting - a high-touch, partner-dependent service model (https://www.woodbridgelawfirm.com/testimonials/)
Avvo review for partner John Gregory (5.0, 1 review) praises responsiveness, thoroughness and organization (https://www.avvo.com/personal-injury-lawyer/nj/woodbridge.html)

No negative or mixed review themes could be retrieved; Google, Yelp and BBB review pages were blocked to automated access, so complaint patterns (missed calls, delays, billing) are unverified either way (https://www.woodbridgelawfirm.com/testimonials/)
tech_footprint: WordPress site with Yoast SEO schema markup and a custom theme, built/maintained by an outside agency ('Website by BFM' - BiggerFishMarketing) (https://www.woodbridgelawfirm.com/)
Gravity Forms with reCAPTCHA powers the appointment/contact form; form submissions are the only structured lead capture (https://www.woodbridgelawfirm.com/)
Tawk.to live-chat widget embedded sitewide - a free-tier chat tool with no visible routing or hours configuration (https://www.woodbridgelawfirm.com/)

Google Tag Manager container GTM-WN2F2LK plus a retired Universal Analytics property (UA-158529786-1), suggesting analytics was set up years ago and never migrated to GA4 (https://www.woodbridgelawfirm.com/)
Google Website Translator plugin and a separate /espanol-php/ section provide Spanish content (https://www.woodbridgelawfirm.com/)
No client portal, no online scheduling, no documented CRM or case-management system visible from public pages (https://www.woodbridgelawfirm.com/)

Homepage HTML contains an off-screen, absolute-positioned link with keyword anchor 'web design nj' pointing to an unrelated domain - a leftover SEO artifact that signals loose site governance (https://www.woodbridgelawfirm.com/)
Content marketing dormant: latest blog posts are from 2021 and page-level sitemap timestamps cluster in 2019-2023 (https://www.woodbridgelawfirm.com/blog/)
growth_signals: Three-office footprint (Iselin HQ plus New Brunswick and Shrewsbury by-appointment locations) versus the two offices described on older attorney-page copy, suggesting the Shrewsbury location was added later (https://www.woodbridgelawfirm.com/contact-us/)
Published seven-figure results ($4.1M settlement, $2.735M net verdict, $2.6M med-mal recovery) used as a marketing asset (https://www.woodbridgelawfirm.com/verdicts-settlements/)

Awards/accreditation wall: NJ Supreme Court certification, Avvo, American Association for Justice, Middlesex County Bar Association/Foundation, NJ State Bar, Trial Attorneys of New Jersey (https://www.woodbridgelawfirm.com/)
Community and bar involvement (Perth Amboy tennis court sponsorship, CLE co-chairing, county bar foundation trustee) supports local referral flow (https://www.woodbridgelawfirm.com/blog/)

No recent press coverage surfaced: Google News RSS queries for the firm and its managing partner returned only 2015 and 2018 items, none about the firm's growth (https://news.google.com/rss/search?q=%22Spevack+Law+Firm%22)
decision_maker: David R. Spevack, President & Managing Partner — https://www.woodbridgelawfirm.com/attorney/david-r-spevack/

inferences.inference: After-hours new-case calls probably go unanswered or to a personal voicemail despite the 24/7 claim, creating missed-intake risk in a practice area where the first caller often hires the first firm.
inferences.reasoning: The site promises 24/7 availability but publishes 9-5 weekday and Saturday-morning staffed hours, and shows no answering service, virtual receptionist vendor, or after-hours scheduling tool in the page source.

inferences.inference: Intake screening is largely manual and human-dependent, so response speed likely varies with who is at the desk.
inferences.reasoning: One phone number and one generic web form serve 12+ practice areas; the form collects no qualification data, and the form's 'Consultation For' dropdown is the only routing logic visible.

inferences.inference: The firm likely has a modest support staff (roughly one to two non-lawyers per attorney) rather than a large intake department.
inferences.reasoning: Seven lawyers across three offices with two appointment-only satellite locations and no published staff directory; COVID notice refers to 'attorneys and staff' generically.

inferences.inference: Marketing technology has drifted: analytics never migrated off Universal Analytics (sunset in 2023) and the blog stopped in 2021.
inferences.reasoning: Homepage source still fires UA-158529786-1 alongside GTM, and the blog index's newest items are from March/May 2021.

inferences.inference: Some attorney affiliations on third-party directories may be stale relative to the firm's own roster.
inferences.reasoning: Avvo lists Louis Andrew Mangione under 'Spevack Law Firm' at 525 Green Street, but he is absent from the firm's attorneys page, which the sitemap shows was last modified in 2023.

inferences.inference: A meaningful share of prospective clients are Spanish-speaking, so any intake automation must handle Spanish-language first contact.
inferences.reasoning: The firm runs a dedicated Spanish section, a translate toggle, and testimonials and bios emphasize Spanish fluency.

data_gaps: Google Business Profile, Yelp and BBB review counts/ratings could not be retrieved (HTTP 403/429 to automated access), so public review volume and complaint themes are unknown.
No headcount, revenue, case volume or staff-directory figures are published anywhere on the site.
Indeed, LinkedIn and ZipRecruiter blocked automated access (HTTP 403); SimplyHired and Talent.com showed no firm listings, so historical hiring activity and typical roles could not be established.

Web search providers were rate-limited/unavailable for most of this session, so discovery relied on direct fetches of the firm's site, Avvo city pages, Google News RSS and job-board search pages; third-party commentary may exist that was not found.
The opening date and staffing of the Shrewsbury office are unconfirmed; site copy elsewhere still says 'offices in Iselin and New Brunswick'.
Current case-management/CRM software and phone system vendors are not disclosed publicly; the COVID page only says systems and phones are remotely accessible.
Whether the Tawk.to chat is actively monitored (and during which hours) could not be determined without initiating a chat, which was out of scope.
